gate_1.evidence: EXP_0018: the closest available test — two photos of the same garment (front and back of one pair) — returns waist widths of 874 px and 191 px, because SAM segmented a back pocket instead of the garment at score 0.906. The pipeline is not repeatable across two photos of one garment, and no automatic mask-validity check we tried (area, compactness, denim colour, fabric texture, leg topology) separates a confident mistake from a correct mask. Human mask verification is now required for anything entering a prior (data/external/mask_verdicts.json).

gate_2.evidence: 2D baseline preserves everything outside the cut by construction: changed_pixel_fraction_outside == 0.0 on every real pair (EXP_0003/0004, experiments/pairs/*/cmp_median/metrics.json); logos/pockets/seams untouched (judge report 2026-08-29: 5/5 same-garment for the prediction). Cut geometry reproduced automatically on the found pairs. SCOPE (2026-08-29, review 4 finding 13): this holds for the pixel-copy configuration (run_pair default, predict.py --wash none). tools/predict.py defaults to --wash median, whose shrink/hem-roll/dye-loss terms DO alter kept pixels; every prediction.json therefore reports changed_fraction_of_kept_region, and the gate does not certify that configuration.
